question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at MN as shown below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e963d69552be93331f358e4b268ec9e34053d95af6a9210158e9a83bd5dfa331.png]
solution:
The correct mirror image of the given figure when the mirror is held on the right side.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a9ccfb3f861c830815c47868562e40eeecd35bc9a50eb31f9737ce86d73cc8e.png] 

__Detailed Explanation:__

__
 
• The correct mirror image of the given figure is " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7657d54480286ee7e1f14d434f8653fab8435619c2e51a16e16b240ae501cd64.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7657d54480286ee7e1f14d434f8653fab8435619c2e51a16e16b240ae501cd64.png] " the first alphabet of the given image is 'R' and the correct mirror image of this alphabet is ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/951e1dfb146ee3c7ff5f98ed64d8799ae222c8724a2e3c54c2511c374cda47c6.png] ' but it is wrongly given in Option 1 and Option 2 so it is eliminated.
 
• The correct mirror image of the given figure is " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7657d54480286ee7e1f14d434f8653fab8435619c2e51a16e16b240ae501cd64.png] " the first letter of the given image is 'F' and the incorrect letter image is given so it is incorrect given in Option 4 so it is eliminated.

 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

1) In the mirror image left side and right side changed vice-versa where the top and bottom remain the same.

2) In a real given mirror image the farthest number or alphabet appears closest in the mirror image.
